Name: JP's Farms - Four Seasons Farm
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][b][i][color=#00ff00][size=6][u]Four Seasons Farm[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia]

[b][i][color=#00ffff][size=5]Why wait for that time of year to grow when you can just go to the next farm![/size][/color][/i][/b]
[/font]
[list]

[*][font=Georgia][size=4]A farm divided into 4 connected maps, each with a season.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Each section corresponds to a season where you can only sow seeds of that season.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]The Spring and Fall farms produce harvestables every day, the Summer farm has a quarry. The winter farm has special grass for animals, and animals will be able to go out even in bad weather on this map.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i][color=#ff7700]Original size of the Standard Farm (80x65) >>> Each of these maps (80x80) + Cliffs removed for more space in general.[/color][/i][/b][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]
[youtube]hN10ZL3g-lk[/youtube]
[color=#ff0000][size=5][i]This is a fairly general summary of what you will find but I hope you like it![/i][/size][/color]

[/font]
[b][font=Georgia][i][color=#ff0000][size=5][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; you don't need to ask my permission.
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods. [color=#00ffff](Recommended)[/color]
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size]

[/font][/b]
